items.text:
Casting Callout! Santa in Manchester!

We are looking for performers with that warmth and twinkle in their eye that can make children of all ages believe in the magic of Christmas and in Santa. Our grotto is going to be bringing Christmas magic to the Trafford centre. 

We are specifically looking for someone who can work 17th, 18th, 21st, 22nd, 28th, 29th Nov, 5th, 6th, 10th, 11th, 12th, 17th, 19th, 20th, 21st and 23rd of Dec. If you can't do all those dates not a prob, any availability you have between 17th Nov and Dec 24th would be good to know.

Owing to the nature of the beard the client wants to use for consistency across all Santas it would mean that performers need to be clean shaven. 

The pay rate is £18 p/h, basically it translates to £243 per day for full days and then varying rates for shorter shifts. Covering the run of dates that I listed above would translate to total pay of £3192 plus there is also a bonus system in place meaning that people who work all their agreed grotto shifts get £10 per shift in addition to their regular pay. We vary the shift lengths that people work so they aren't working full length days back to back so as to not get too tired or run down as we have performer welfare as our number 1 priority at all times. 

If you are interested please drop an email to performance@bakehousefactory.co.uk

Do pierwszego odcinka 2. sezonu serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję kobiet do nastepujących ról:

1.Roksana (19) – młoda, ładna, pracuje w kawiarni jako barmanka/baristka. Dziewczyna z problemami psychicznymi.
Data: 26 i 27.10
Stawka: 1600 zł netto

2.Joanna (37) – przeciętna kobieta z przemocowej rodziny, zaniedbana, wystraszona   
Data: 27.10
Stawka: 800 zł netto

3. Śledcza (37) – zadbana śledcza, konkretna, rzeczowa.
Data: 30.10
Stawka: 500 zł netto

4.Iwona (41) – kobieta po stracie dziecka, załamana, rozbita, wrak człowieka. Chorobliwie szczupła i zniszczona problemami.  
Data: 30.10
Stawka: 700 zł netto

Chętne Panie zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

🎥 In diesem Reel spricht Dr. Meike Lauggas über die Möglichkeit des Miteinander-Sprechens um schwierige Situationen zu verarbeiten. 

👉 Sei dabei beim nächsten KBF! ✨☕️ 

📍 176. Künstler*innen Business Frühstück 
 🗓️ Dienstag, 13.10.2026 – 7:15 Uhr 
 🏨 Hotel Zeitgeist Vienna, Sonnwendgasse 15, 1100 Wien 

💬 Vortrag: Förderung und Verwertung in Österreich 
 🎙️ Emanuel Treu 
 🎤 Moderation: Michael Weilguny 

Welche Fördermöglichkeiten stehen Musikschaffenden in Österreich zur Verfügung? Was ist bei Anträgen zu beachten – und welche typischen Fehler lassen sich vermeiden? 

Der international tätige Songwriter und Musiker, Coach und Buchautor Emanuel Treu gibt einen kompakten Überblick über Projektförderungen, Stipendien und langfristige Unterstützungsangebote. Als Vorstandsmitglied der AKM beleuchtet er außerdem das Thema „Money-In“: Wie funktioniert die Verwertung eigener Werke konkret, welche Rolle spielen AKM, VOET & Co. – und wie können Musikschaffende sicherstellen, dass ihr kreatives Schaffen auch finanziell wirksam wird? 

Ein Frühstück für alle, die Fördermöglichkeiten gezielter nutzen, ihre Anträge überzeugend gestalten und ihre Rechte sowie finanziellen Chancen als Musikschaffende besser verstehen möchten. 

📲 Mehr Infos: 
Website: www.KünstlerBusinessFrühstück.at  
Facebook: https://fb.me/e/7qZOEkrz6

ECHO | LONDON OPEN CALL 2026
Group Exhibition
2–5 November 2026
Blank Canvas Gallery, London
Presented by Yune Art
With media support from Harper’s BAZAAR

THEME

ECHO explores what remains after an event, a gesture, a relationship or a generation has passed.

Expectations surrounding family, gender, the body and identity can travel across generations, changing as they move between different people, environments and cultural contexts.

The exhibition considers how emotional residue, cultural memory and inherited experience are transformed through time, migration, material and the body, eventually resurfacing in new and sometimes unexpected forms.

We welcome submissions exploring themes including generational experience, memory, identity, family structures, gender, the body, inheritance, and transformation.

Submissions are particularly encouraged from artists mainly working with glass, textile, sound, sculpture, installation, although other contemporary practices will also be considered.

SELECTED ARTISTS WILL RECEIVE
- Physical exhibition in London
- Media support and exposure through Harper’s BAZAAR
- Opportunities for artwork sales
- Professional exhibition documentation
- International promotional exposure

SUBMISSION DETAILS
Submission Fee: Free
Exhibition Fee: Applicable to selected artists only
Submission Deadline: 26 October 2026
Exhibition Dates: 2–5 November 2026
Venue: Blank Canvas Gallery, London SW6 7EJ

To apply, please submit your portfolio+ artist/work statement to:
yune.art@outlook.com

https://www.instagram.com/yune_art_official?stkn=MTJyODhzYWVvcGhhdA%3D%3D&utm_source=qr

These are paid roles. Please do not submit if you are not reliable or unable to attend scheduled rehearsals. These are every Tuesday and Thursday via Zoom, 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM, and in person every 1st and 3rd Saturdays from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM. Franklin: Male, age range 27 to 33. Full of life, funny, always has jokes, and sings his heart out. However, he's keeping a secret boyfriend that he thinks no one in the family knows about. Must be comfortable playing a gay role and must be able to sing.

Stanley: Male, age range 25 to 30. Cool, laid-back, friendly guy unlike his sister and mother.  

For submissions: Taraentertainmentllc@gmail.com

items.text:
I’m absolutely appalled by what’s happening at South Grand Prairie High School. A student auditioned for Little Shop of Horrors, earned the role of Seymour, and then had that role taken away because she’s a girl. Now, the entire production has been canceled.

As a music educator and the artistic director of Wedgwood Arts, I spend an enormous amount of time encouraging young performers to take risks, step outside their comfort zones, and discover what they’re capable of. That’s what theater does. That’s what arts education is supposed to do.

Cross-gender casting isn’t some radical new concept. It’s been part of theater for centuries. A girl playing Seymour isn’t inherently a drag performance. It’s ACTING.

And perhaps the most infuriating part? Grand Prairie ISD’s motto is “All In for All Kids.”

All kids? Really? From where I’m standing, it looks an awful lot like “All In for All Kids… Terms and Conditions Apply.”

An entire cast has lost the opportunity to create something wonderful because adults couldn’t get past the gender of a fictional character. We should be opening doors for these kids, not slamming them shut.

I hope this story reaches every corner of the theater and arts education communities. These students deserve to be heard, and they deserve better.

Here is a direct link to Ana’s Instagram post, where you can hear her story in her own words. Please take a moment to read it, listen to her perspective, and remember that behind every headline are real students whose opportunities and experiences matter.

https://www.instagram.com/p/DeQnGxdt_wv/

topComments.text: CD here. For national casting we usually pay for all travel, hotel and expenses plus a small travel fee. But if the casting is looking for local hire only, we do not cover travel or expenses and you are expected to travel in on your own dime

We have for multiple large campaigns.  
If they are paying your travel you can expect if.  If you are working as rival hire, obviously no.

Hallo liebe Erdinger! 👋

Wir suchen Märchenfiguren für den Wintermärchenmarkt Erding 2027!

Vom 6. bis 10. Januar 2027 verwandelt sich Erding wieder in ein Märchenland, und wir brauchen euch dafür.

Ob Hexe, König, Zauberer, Fee, Ritter, Zwerg oder eine andere Märchenfigur. Wer Lust hat, Kinder und Familien zu verzaubern, ist herzlich willkommen.

Was ihr mitbringen müsst:
Freude am Mitmachen und ein Kostüm (oder eine Idee dafür). Keine Erfahrung nötig!

Was wir euch bieten:
Als Dankeschön für euren Einsatz bekommt ihr 25 Kästen Bier (150 Liter) geschenkt. Für eure nächste Vereinsfeier, euren Grillabend oder einfach für euch. Das Bier gehört euch, komplett und zum Mitnehmen!

Einfach hier kommentieren oder uns direkt schreiben. Wir freuen uns auf euch!

Wintermärchenmarkt Erding | 6. bis 10. Januar 2027 | Eintritt frei

---

So ist klar: Das Bier gibt es als Geschenk zum Mitnehmen, nicht als Freigetränk auf dem Markt.

TEL:0177/3889012

📸 Models für ein Fahrradhelmshooting in München gesucht!
Du hast bereits Shootingerfahrungen gesammelt und nächste Woche Zeit? Dann melde dich bei uns! 🙌

Bei Alphatrail entwickeln wir hochwertige Fahrradhelme und Zubehör. Jetzt fotografieren wir unsere brandneuen Premiumfahrradhelme in München.

Wir stecken viel Leidenschaft in unsere Produkte. Diese Leidenschaft bringen wir auch ins Shooting ein, mit Liebe zum Detail und dem Anspruch, gemeinsam hochwertige Bilder zu schaffen.

Dafür suchen wir eine männliche und eine weibliche Person aus dem Raum München, die offen und zuverlässig sind und optisch etwa 25 bis 35 Jahre alt wirken. Entscheidend ist der passende Look, nicht dein tatsächliches Alter.

Bin ich geeignet?

✅ Shootingerfahrungen

✅ Leidenschaftlicher Fahrradfahrer

✅ Teamplayer

📍 Ort: München

📅 Zeitraum: Mittwoch, 14.10., bis Samstag, 17.10.2026, konkrete Einsatzzeiten nach Absprache

💶 Vergütung: nach vorheriger Vereinbarung

✨ Auch Personen ohne eigenes Gewerbe sind willkommen!

👉 Interesse? Schreib mir direkt eine private Nachricht mit zwei bis drei aktuellen Fotos, einer kurzen Info zu deiner Shootingerfahrung und deiner Verfügbarkeit.

Du kennst jemanden, der passen könnte? Teile den Beitrag gerne weiter! 😊

#ModelsGesucht #ShootingMünchen #ModelCasting #Alphatrail #Fahrradhelm

Kraków. Szukam aktorów do spektaklu amatorskiej grupy

Do spektaklu psychologicznego w realiach II wojny światowej poszukuję aktora, który wcieli się w główną rolę - Tadeusza (pierwowzór Tadeusz Borowski i Wincenty Gawron). Planowana premiera: koniec listopada. W gorszym układzie: wiosna 27. Projekt tworzony jest przez entuzjastów teatru, z prywatnych środków. Wynagrodzenie: podział z biletów. 

Zachęcam do zgłoszenia. Wprawdzie nie możemy obiecać zawrotnej kariery, ale na pewno będzie można przeżyć ciekawą  historię. 

Dziękuję, pozdrawiam.

🎬 CASTING CALL!
Hi! I’m Fé from Just Russel 👋

Just Russel is a Belgian brand that creates personalised food for dogs and cats. 🐶🐱

We’re currently looking for new faces in Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and France who enjoy being in front of the camera.

For our videos, we’re looking for people who feel comfortable on camera and enjoy creating fun, natural content.

You don’t need to have a pet yourself, we can provide one for the shoot. 😉 But if you do have a four-legged friend who also enjoys being in front of the camera, they’re more than welcome to join!

The most important thing is that you feel comfortable on camera and with an animal by your side on set.

Would you like to be part of our content?

Just fill in the form and who knows, maybe we’ll see you on set soon! 🎥

নিজস্ব সংবাদদাতা: মানবিক উদ্যোগ ও সামাজিক দায়বদ্ধতার বার্তা নিয়ে আদিবাসী ও পিছিয়ে পড়া জনজাতির শিশুদের পাশে দাঁড়াল আলোর ইশকুল। সংগঠনের উদ্যোগে আজ শিশুদের হাতে তুলে দেওয়া হলো নতুন পোশাক। এই উদ্যোগের মূল উদ্দেশ্য শিশুদের মুখে হাসি ফোটানো এবং তাদের পাশে থেকে সমাজের প্রতি দায়বদ্ধতার পরিচয় দেওয়া।

নতুন পোশাক পেয়ে শিশুদের মধ্যে আনন্দ ও উৎসাহের পরিবেশ তৈরি হয়। সমাজের পিছিয়ে পড়া অংশের শিশুদের পাশে দাঁড়িয়ে তাদের মুখে হাসি ফোটানোর এই উদ্যোগ নিঃসন্দেহে প্রশংসনীয়।

এই কর্মসূচিতে আলোর ইশকুলের সদস্যবৃন্দ এবং উপস্থিত ছিলেন বিশিষ্ট সমাজসেবী গণ।। এই বস্ত্র বিতরণ অনুষ্ঠান আলোকিত করেছেন সমাজসেবী,, সঞ্জিত দাস, উত্তম ঘোষ, তেতুল চন্দ্র বিশ্বাস, কেয়া দাস, জয়দেব সরকার ও বুলটি সরকার। তাঁদের উপস্থিতিতে পোশাক বিতরণ কর্মসূচি সম্পন্ন হয়।

আলোর ইশকুলের এই উদ্যোগ সমাজের সর্বস্তরের মানুষের কাছে মানবিকতা, সহমর্মিতা ও সামাজিক দায়বদ্ধতার এক সুন্দর বার্তা পৌঁছে দিল। শিশুদের উজ্জ্বল ভবিষ্যৎ গড়ে তুলতে এবং তাদের মুখে হাসি ফোটাতে এ ধরনের উদ্যোগ আগামী দিনেও গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ভূমিকা পালন করবে বলে আশা করা যায়।

আলোর ইশকুলের এই মানবিক উদ্যোগকে জানাই আন্তরিক অভিনন্দন ও শুভেচ্ছা।

It is a sapphic romance and thriller short film - set in a retro-futuristic world. Filming will take place in Cheltenham and Gloucester around early to end of November this year (dates to be decided). Travel expenses will be covered and food will be provided.

If you are interested please email me at emmamgfilm@gmail.com and or send me a message through here 🙏 alongside please list your availability in November 

Thanks, Emma :)

items.text:
CASTING CALL: Out, Amongst the Stars

Project Type: Independent feature film

Genre: Sci-fi, Adventure

Tone: Character-driven, dialogue-heavy and incorporating visual effects.

Production Dates: TBC late October-November-December 2026

Location: Leeds and surrounding West Yorkshire area, UK

Pay Rate: Voluntary only. Complimentary copy of the completed film. Cast members can extract their scenes for Showreel purposes from the completed film. Gala screening invite.

Stills, BTS and editorial coverage where possible. The film will be listed on IMDB.

Auditions: To be held in Leeds.

PROJECT SYNOPSIS: 

Forty-six years ago, amid rumours of UFO sightings and government cover-ups, an ordinary family man vanished without a trace. Abi, his now middle-aged daughter, uncovers a truth no one wanted to face – that there was an extraterrestrial visitation, her father's disappearance was no accident, and for reasons still unknown, whatever took him is about to return...

Production scope overview:

Out, Amongst The Stars is the sixth feature film from production company WOTR. This is a microbudget feature film to shoot mainly in Leeds and the surrounding West Yorkshire area.

We are only considering cast who have a base in the region. The main shoot will be approximately 5 weeks, Mondays to Fridays. The completed film will be sent to film festivals and streaming services. The film has a large cast contingent, so other casting notices will follow.

LEAD ROLES:

-Dr. Abi Sherwood (daughter)

Age Range: late 40s to early 50s

Gender: Female

Ethnicity: British White

Character Description: Grounded. Very intelligent, relatable. Science nerd. Dry

sense of humour. Caring. Joyous.

-Usman (scientist, colleague, friend)

Age Range: late 30s to 40s

Gender: Male

Ethnicity: Black Asian

Character Description: GSOH, dependable, smart, witty. Sincere.

-Sergei (scientist)

Age Range: 40s

Gender: Male

Ethnicity: White (Slavic/Russian)

Character Description: Rugged, inquisitive nature, academic, kind

-Evi Sherwood (mother)

Age Range: Late 60s to 70s

Gender: Female

Ethnicity: White

Character Description: Weary, reclusive, academic, drinking issues.

-Adam Sherwood (father)

Age Range: Late 30 to early 40s

Gender: Male

Ethnicity: White

Character Description: Good natured, caring, academic

-Chandraneethan (Theoretical mathematician and Physicist)

Age Range: Late 20s to 30s

Gender: Male

Ethnicity: Indian Asian

Character Description: Confident, gifted Scientist

-Audrey Park (Retired business woman, Wife)

Age Range: Late 50s to 60s

Gender: Female

Ethnicity: Open

Character Description: Stalwart, distraught by events

SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS

Please send the following to [bristylecoaching@outlook.com] with the subject line: [CHARACTER NAME]: [YOUR NAME] - Out, Amogst the Stars Casting Call

-Current Headshot & Resume (PDF format)

-Demo Reel or Video Clip link (Spotlight)

-City/State where you are currently based

I look forward to connecting with You!

With Love & Health,

Bri Miller (Casting Director)

For more information and introductions about our project, please visit: https://www.facebook.com/OutAmongstTheStars
items.previewDescription: Produced by  northern UK based film production company WOTR.

topComments.text:
Unfortunately, I’m not in the UK.  Sounds like a fun shoot. 
I wanted to thank you for explaining that reel footage is not actually provided, but can be extracted from the finished product. My experience has been that almost all independent films promise footage and don’t then provide it. It’s rare to be actually sent reel footage and rare to be told up front that you’ll have to clip it. So, I appreciate the honesty. Wish I could be there.

📸 Models für ein Fahrradhelmshooting in München gesucht!
Du hast bereits Shootingerfahrungen gesammelt und nächste Woche Zeit? Dann melde dich bei uns! 🙌

Bei Alphatrail entwickeln wir hochwertige Fahrradhelme und Zubehör. Jetzt fotografieren wir unsere brandneuen Premiumfahrradhelme in München.

Wir stecken viel Leidenschaft in unsere Produkte. Diese Leidenschaft bringen wir auch ins Shooting ein, mit Liebe zum Detail und dem Anspruch, gemeinsam hochwertige Bilder zu schaffen.

Dafür suchen wir eine männliche und eine weibliche Person aus dem Raum München, die offen und zuverlässig sind und optisch etwa 25 bis 35 Jahre alt wirken. Entscheidend ist der passende Look, nicht dein tatsächliches Alter.

Bin ich geeignet?

✅ Shootingerfahrungen

✅ Leidenschaftlicher Fahrradfahrer

✅ Teamplayer

📍 Ort: München

📅 Zeitraum: Mittwoch, 14.10., bis Samstag, 17.10.2026, konkrete Einsatzzeiten nach Absprache

💶 Vergütung: nach vorheriger Vereinbarung

✨ Auch Personen ohne eigenes Gewerbe sind willkommen!

👉 Interesse? Schreib mir direkt eine private Nachricht mit zwei bis drei aktuellen Fotos, einer kurzen Info zu deiner Shootingerfahrung und deiner Verfügbarkeit.

Du kennst jemanden, der passen könnte? Teile den Beitrag gerne weiter! 😊

#ModelsGesucht #ShootingMünchen #ModelCasting #Alphatrail #Fahrradhelm

অপেক্ষা... শুধু অপেক্ষা!
অপেক্ষা হ্যাঁ, অপেক্ষা নিয়েই তো বসে আছি আমি। কিন্তু কার অপেক্ষা?
না, আমার কোনো প্রেমিকা নেই। তার অপেক্ষায় বসে নেই আমি। আমি তো অবিবাহিত, তাই স্ত্রীর অপেক্ষা করারও প্রশ্ন ওঠে না। তাহলে কার অপেক্ষা?
বন্ধু? দূর! এই বয়সে নতুন করে বন্ধুত্ব করার মানুষই বা কোথায়? যাঁদের বন্ধু বলে জানি, তাঁরা সবাই নিজেদের সংসার নিয়ে ব্যস্ত।
তাহলে?
আমি অপেক্ষা করছি কাজের। একজন শিল্পী হিসেবে নিজের কাজের।
অপেক্ষা... শুধু অপেক্ষা...

Everything will be directed step by step, so you don’t need any special skills or prior experience. You’ll simply follow instructions and demonstrate the tasks as directed.

The work is straightforward, and the activities may vary from day to day.

Stella 18-24: depressed, Stella struggles to cope with the grief of living and finding a purpose in what life could be

Emory 18-24: Bubbly and optimistic, always tries to see the good in the bad. Attempts to get Stella to let her in more

Unpaid Student film

Hello again! Sorry for such short notice, BUT I am posting this casting call looking for some EXTRA's / BACKGROUND! We're shooting on old timey film, and I would love for scene to be lively with some people :). I attached some screen grabs from the rehearsal we did to show the look we're going for, except the real thing will be more authentic and not just me playing on Premiere haha.

I am mostly looking for someone to play a PARENT and a CHILD! They have this biggest part in interacting with the street mime. Everyone will be asked to run and clear frame at a certain point in the scene as well, so if you cannot run you might not want to come to this one.

*Compensation is copy of the footage (UPON REQUEST) and an IMDB Credit once the film is released :)

If you'd like to be a part of this, please email me :)

CASTING – LONDON-BASED FEMALE PRESENTERS!
MISSIM Management is looking for confident, bubbly and engaging female presenters for ongoing TikTok LIVE fashion selling.

📍 Location: Kensington, London (W14 8XP)

📆 Shifts: 2–3 regular shifts per week

⏰ Duration: 2 hours per shift, potentially extended to 3 hours on busy days

💰 Pay: £30–£40 per hour, depending on experience

AVAILABILITY REQUIREMENTS:

We’re looking for someone who can commit to:

* Every Saturday (regular weekly shift)

* 1–2 additional weekday shifts between 9am–1pm

* A minimum of 2 shifts per week, ideally 3

Previous presenting, TikTok LIVE selling or fashion retail experience is a big advantage!

TO BE CONSIDERED:

Please DM us on Instagram @missimmanagement with:

📸 Your photos

🎥 Speaking/presenting videos

📆 Your regular weekly availability

Please only apply if you can commit to at least 2 regular shifts per week, including Saturdays.

📺 Freut euch schon bald auf den kompletten Beitrag vom Benefiz-Gesangswettbewerb in Dischingen! 🎤✨

Dort präsentiert Jasmin Spiske ihren tollen Song „Warum denn nicht“. Außerdem erwarten euch viele weitere großartige Künstlerinnen und Künstler, die ihre eigenen Songs oder wunderschöne Coverversionen präsentieren. 🎶👏

Ein musikalisches Erlebnis voller Emotionen, toller Stimmen und schöner Momente! ❤️🎵

Der komplette Beitrag erscheint bald auf unserem YouTube-Kanal JSW Fernsehen und bei OK Merseburg TV. Seid gespannt! 📺

🎶 Und vieles mehr bei der Julian Schlager Welt!

❤️ Abonniert unsere Kanäle, folgt uns und lasst gerne ein Herz da. Wir freuen uns über eure Unterstützung!

Schöne Grüße
Euer Julian Wien 🎤❤️

Stawka: 1600 zł netto

Szukamy osób o etnicznej urodzie w wieku 5-17 lat do odgrywania scenek na nagrania w Warszawie (Białołęka) w terminie 13.10-16.10.

1. Czas nagrania - 1 godzina. Dokładny termin i godziny do uzgodnienia.

2. Zależy nam na dużej różnorodności etnicznej dzieci.

3. Wynagrodzenie za udział dziecka: 300 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po zleceniu — BLIK/konto bankowe).

W razie zainteresowania prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia dziecka, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy do rodzica

5. Adres e-mail do rodzica

6. Wzrost

7. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Nagrania-Scenki

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w projekcie zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

As part of a project with Luca School of Arts, we flemish students are collaborating with up-and-coming artists to create a music video for them. We’re still looking for two actors to help us on October 16 and 17 in Brussels. The song is “Hou mij tegen” by “Floris Francis Arthur,” and the story is (in short) about a couple who drift apart after a miscarriage. If you’re interested, I’ll send you more information.

�So we’re looking for a man and a woman who look to be around 30–32 years old.

If you’re interested, feel free to send me a message. You can also call me anytime at +32 471 03 09 43 or send an email to margodefrancq@gmail.com

Best regards,

Margo Defrancq

Do pierwszego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję mężczyzn do nastepujących ról:
 
1.Sebastian (27) – kierownik kawiarni, szczupły, przystojny i zadbany. Pozytywny gość. 
Data: 26.10
Stawka: 800 zł netto

2.Miłosz (46) – adopcyjny ojciec Roksany, przeciętny facet zniszczony życiem, w depresji.  
Data: 26.10
Stawka: 800 zł netto

3.Diler (27) – cwaniakowaty diler, łysy, wygadany.  
Data: 26.10
Stawka: 400 zł netto

4.Rowerzysta (41) – wysportowany rowerzysta, konkretny, rzeczowy  
Data: 26.10
Stawka: 500 zł netto

5.Paweł (44) – alkoholik i przemocowiec, wyżyłowany, zaniedbany zarost, krótkie włosy. 
Data: 26 i 27.10
Stawka: 1600 zł netto

6.Lekarz (61) – konkretny i rzeczowy lekarz, zadbany 
Data: 27.10
Stawka: 500 zł netto

7. Damian Wisłocki (28) – wysportowany, groźna aparycja, gangster. Krótki zarost  – konieczne prawo jazdy
Data: 27 i 30.10
Stawka: 1600 / 1702

Chętnych Panów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

**ĆWICZENIA Z WOLNOŚCI**

Zapraszam na moje pierwsze w Polsce regularne warsztaty treningowo-kreatywne dla osób aktorskich i performerskich zainteresowanych eksploracją warsztatu i własnego języka twórczego (cotygodniowe spotkania w Warszawie od listopada). 

Trening poprowadzi nas przez cztery etapy inspirowane podziałem Teatru Reduty — Zabawę, Przeżywanie, Przeistoczenie i Obrzędowość, a moduł eksploracji indywidualnej poetyki będzie oparty na zadaniach kreatywnych autorstwa hiszpańskiego twórcy Carlosa Tuñóna.

Chciałbym przede wszystkich dotrzeć do osób, które mają potrzebę rozwijać swój język twórczy i być inicjatorami autorskich projektów.

**PEŁNA INFORMACJA:**  [https://tomaszborczyk.pl/project/cwiczenia-z-wolnosci-warsztaty-roczne-2026-2027/](https://tomaszborczyk.pl/project/cwiczenia-z-wolnosci-warsztaty-roczne-2026-2027/)** **** **

📅 Start: 5 listopada 2026, czwartki 10:00–15:00
📍 ul. Tamka 40, Warszawa
💰 600 zł/miesiąc *
👥 12 miejsc

* Jeśli ktoś jest bardzo zainteresowany udziałem, ale cena jest dla niego/niej zbyt wysoka, proszę o kontakt. 

Termin zgłoszeń: 30 października 2026.

Prowadzi: Tomasz Borczyk, aktor i twórca teatralny (RESAD Madryt, dyrektor artystyczny kolektywu Noche de Camaleones, obecnie współpracujący z Instytutem Grotowskiego i Komuną Warszawa)

CASTING WARSZAWA – TIKTOK
!!! Stała współpraca !!! ( PL/EN/RU/UA) 

PILNIE JUTRO !! ( 14.10 ) 

!!! Stała współpraca !!!

Szukamy CHARAKTERYSTYCZNYCH, WYRAZISTYCH OSÓB do krótkich materiałów na TikTok.
Nie szukamy modeli ani klasycznych „reklamowych” twarzy.
Interesuje nas praktycznie KAŻDY typ wyglądu, który przyciąga uwagę i zostaje w pamięci.
Możesz być:

– bardzo szczupły lub bardzo postawny

– niski, wysoki, drobny albo masywny

– starszy lub młodszy

– mieć nietypowe rysy twarzy lub sylwetkę

– charakterystyczną fryzurę, brodę, wąsy, tatuaże, blizny

– bardzo zwyczajny, ale po prostu mieć „to coś”

– wyglądać nietypowo, ekscentrycznie, surowo, zabawnie albo zupełnie niepasująco do klasycznych standardów reklamowych

Nie ma jednego konkretnego typu.

Najważniejsze jest to, żeby Twój wygląd był WYRAZISTY i żeby człowiek chciał spojrzeć drugi raz.

Doświadczenie aktorskie NIE jest wymagane.

Well, I'm back!

I took a little break from Stage Ready to work in a major touring production office. Learned a lot, met some great people, and now I'm back doing what I love.

I've recently been talking with a few international entertainment agencies, and some interesting opportunities are opening up.

I've spoken with a lot of you over the years and worked with quite a few of you in different capacities. Even if you've submitted for one of my previous castings, please reach out again. This is something different.

Right now I'm looking for exciting, fast-paced variety acts ready for cruise ships and international gigs. I'm open to just about anything. The more creative, unusual, and entertaining, the better!

Here's what I need:

Two different 45-minute shows (A and B).

At least 10 minutes of unedited live performance footage on YouTube.

Promo reel, photos, bio, show descriptions, and technical rider.

Everything organized in a Google Drive folder.

A social media following is a big plus!

If you've got all that, I want to talk to you ASAP. I'm looking to get some qualified acts in front of these agencies.

If you're not quite there yet, that's okay too. I also help performers develop material, build full-length shows, and put together packages that can compete internationally. Just let me know where you're at and what you need help with.

And about the pictures below...

I've done my share of ridiculous gigs over the years. I've also been lucky enough create and tour my own brand and act internationally. I know what it's like to be on both sides of this business. If you're ready to go from this to this, let's talk.

Send me a DM. I'd love to see what you've got!

Patrick
Stage Ready CGT Management

items.text:
CASTING CALL FOR MODELS/ACTORS - UNPAID STUDENT SHORT
‘Bloom’ is a poetic documentary, exploring the reality of women living with debilitating menstrual conditions, and the medical misogyny leaving their pain overlooked. 

We are looking for a female - presenting model or actress who would be interested in helping us to create some recreational scenes for visuals within the documentary. 

The role would be no dialogue (mainly mime and body language)

Please note that because this is a student short, the budget is unfortunately small so the role will be unpaid however travel and food will be provided. 

If you are interested, please reach out either via email or mobile (featured in the poster above!)

items.text: Hi my daughter age 14 has been in acting classes for a few years now and wants to cast, where’s the best place to start or look please?

topComments.text:
You can join sites like Mandy and keep an eye out for open castings for lower budget Indie films etc but be vigilant, do your due diligence and ensure it is properly licensed.
The vast majority of professional work is cast via Spotlight for which she needs an agent. Unfortunately age 14 is pretty much the worst age to try to start and it may be better to wait until after GCSES and things pick up a little, agencies may be more receptive etc... right now unless she is tiny and looks young so could pass for age 11 there are very few opportunities indeed especially without previous experience and agencies already have their books full of teens who have been doing it for years all chasing very few opportunities... It costs at least £300 per year to have Spotlight and Headshots before any other costs... It is also generally very quiet in the industry... My 14 year old has lots of experience but auditions are more and more rare.

It's a really tough age as a teen coupled with it being really quiet at the moment.  Can check out open castings on instagram or sites like Mandy but finding an agent gives best chance.  Needs to be looking as young as possible

items.text:
**PAID CASTING CALL — ADULT ACTORS**

Windstar Studios is casting several roles for an upcoming commercial filming in Colorado Springs.

We are looking for:
* **Two women, approximately 60–70 years old**, to portray friends enjoying coffee together. All demographics welcome.
* **Father and adult son**, with the father approximately 50–60 years old and the son in his mid-20s. Must plausibly portray father and son. Real father-son pairs are encouraged to apply.
* **Two adults**, **approximately 30–40 years old,** to portray the parents of an infant. The baby has already been cast, so we're looking for actors who can believably portray the child's parents.

**Age ranges are flexible for actors who are a good fit for the roles.**

**Production details:**
* **Shoot dates:** October 20–21
* **Pay:** $400–$800 per actor, depending on role and usage, including rights for use in perpetuity
* **Location:** Colorado Springs, CO

Interested actors, please send me a private message or email **[jegraham@adproresults.com](mailto:jegraham@adproresults.com)** with your age, recent photos or headshots, acting experience (if applicable), and availability for October 20–21.

Selected applicants may be asked to submit a short self-tape audition.

**Production company:** Windstar Studios

items.text:
Hello Actors, my name is Jennifer Roberson & I am a talent agent with The Wayne Agency and the agency headquarters are in Los Angeles.  I am sharing this opportunity again and if you have not already submitted for this, I would encourage you to do so quickly. We are in the process of narrowing down our selections for the    in-person auditions. Below is all of the information. 

The Wayne Agency is expanding their roster & is hosting an open call for actors looking for representation in the Atlanta, South Central/Texas, Los Angeles, Virginia/East and New York markets.  Ages 5 and up.  There is no fee with this reputable open call and no fees attached and there will be no costs if signed.  We are a proud SAG-AFTRA franchised agency governed by SAG-AFTRA rules.  For the audition, please prepare a 30-60 second commercial (that you connect with and can show us your “brand”) and also either a scene or a monologue.  If you select a scene, you may perform a scene from tv/film and please keep it between 2-3 pages. **OR** for a monologue, please perform a piece that is no longer than 1-2 minutes.  If we are interested, we will reach out to you to schedule an in-person audition time in the Denver area between October 30th-November 1st.  Please submit the Google form below.  If you do NOT have a GMAIL account, please send everything listed on the Google form to the email address: [twashowcase@gmail.com](mailto:twashowcase@gmail.com).  If you have a question, please ask it here. And please check out our website: [https://www.thewayneagency.com/](https://urldefense.proofpoint.com/v2/url?u=https-3A__www.thewayneagency.com_&d=DwMFaQ&c=euGZstcaTDllvimEN8b7jXrwqOf-v5A_CdpgnVfiiMM&r=o8JSr2h6ujNaDfELoLPC65IJVNeuU24Z4w1rP9idmLE&m=FdJWRu-Lu0jmEpoXGZU5JTg6gievjZQr9R7oYXoApBVoIaqJpebQR3JX897EmLzD&s=io2WPYSjpcbjWTnt_Ic1cOeHsmZOO2EV16b429WqH8o&e=)

🎬 CASTING: dziewczyny 18+ do nagrania na duży kanał YouTube

Szukamy 15 dziewczyn do nagrania na dynamicznie rosnący kanał YouTube (60 tys. subskrypcji) z dużymi zasięgami.

Format: białe studio, jeden chłopak i 10 dziewczyn. Każda po kolei ma z nim swoją „randkę” przed kamerą. Format jest rozrywkowy i z humorem, reakcje prowadzącego bywają przerysowane i ostre. Szczegóły dostaniesz przed nagraniem, bez niespodzianek na planie.

Co możesz zyskać:
�📈 promocję swojej osoby przed dużą widownią�📲 oznaczenie i promocję Twojego Instagrama i TikToka�🤝 szansę na dłuższą współpracę przy kolejnych nagraniach

Na miejscu zapewniamy:
�🍕 jedzenie i napoje (również alkohol)�🚗 zwrot kosztów dojazdu�🚉 odbiór z dworca lub ze wskazanego miejsca na terenie Warszawy

Kogo szukamy:
�✅ wyłącznie osoby pełnoletnie (dowód sprawdzany na miejscu)�✅ różne typy urody, sylwetki, style i roczniki: młodsze, starsze, każda inna�✅ luz przed kamerą, poczucie humoru, odwaga�✅ doświadczenie nie jest wymagane

📍 Warszawa. Termin nagrania podamy wkrótce, teraz zbieramy zgłoszenia.�
📩 Zgłoszenia: 
na pv bądź przez formularz - https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdsIfnTL10m72TRTuxDS-GJaMHitsU8Ta_4z_dV5B9WKrIwtQ/viewform

Zgłoś się albo oznacz koleżankę, która się nada 👇

Do nowego sezonu serialu GLINIARZE realizowanego w Warszawie oraz bliskich okolicach szukam PANÓW:

- "Szyna" (39) –  Gangster. Od lat mieszka i działa w Niemczech. Dobra sylwetka. 
Data: 27.10 i 28.10
Stawka: 1000 zł netto za 2 dni

- „Zapalnik” (50) – cyngiel na zlecenie, spec od materiałów wybuchowych. Inteligentny, okulary.
Data: 29.10 i 30.10
Stawka: 1000 zł netto za 2 dni

- Roman Kabecki (45) – skorumpowany prokurator. Przy kasie, modnie ubrany. 
Data: 30.10
Stawka: 600 zł netto

- Tomasz Marczak (38)  – szemrany biznesmen, karany za korumpowanie urzędników skarbowych. Chce wyglądać jak biznesmen, ale wygląda mocno podejrzanie. 
Data: 30.10
Stawka: 600 zł netto

- „Siekiera” (40) – gangster z Poznania, wygląd niebezpiecznego kryminalisty, napakowany, dziary. 
Data: 30.10
Stawka: 600 zł netto

- Szymon Adamski (41) – tajniak, pracuje w wydziale narkotykowym komendy stołecznej. Twardziel. 
Data: 27.10
Stawka: 500 zł netto

- Kostur (29) – Prawa ręka Winiego. Narwany, agresywny. Ubiera się w dres. Dobra sylwetka. 
Data: 27.10
Stawka: 500 zł netto

- Wini (42) –  Szef gangu. Cwaniak. Traktuje innych z wyższością. Przeciętna sylwetka.
Data: 27.10
Stawka: 500 zł netto

- Adrian Rogowski (37) – Pracuje jako bramkarz w klubach. Impulsywny, typ przemocowca, zaborczy i bardzo zazdrosny.
Data: 27.10
Stawka: 500 zł netto

- Kumpel (30) – kumpel Palucha, drobny kryminalista. Typ dresika-cwaniaczka. 
Data: 19.10
Stawka: 400 zł netto

- Świadek (33) – Przypadkowy mężczyzna, przechodzień. 
Data: 27.10
Stawka: 400 zł netto

- Informator (50) – funkcjonariusz ABN, znajomy Szwarca.
Data: 29.10
Stawka: 400 zł netto

- Ratownik medyczny (36) – konkretny facet, pomocny, zna się na swoim fachu.
Data: 28.10
Stawka: 300 zł netto

- Gangster – mafijny żołnierz, sportowa sylwetka.
Data: 30.10
Stawka: 300 zł netto

Zainteresowanych Panów proszę o zgłoszenia WYŁĄCZNIE MAILOWO na adres: outsetola@op.pl

W tytule e-maila proszę o wpisanie nazwy postaci (można startować do kilku ról).

W treści:
- Wiek, wzrost, waga
- Numer telefonu
- Informacje o dotychczasowym doświadczeniu przed kamerą
- Linki do swoich materiałów video: wizytówka/demo/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę do nagrania scenę ze scenariusza)
- Aktualne zdjęcie
- Informacja czy grali Państwo w przeszłości w Gliniarzach lub Gliniarzach Śląsk.

Szukam osób na plan reklamy  jednej z platform zakupowych jako pracowników biura.

Wiek 20-60 lat

Zdjęcia Warszawa 17.10

Sobota. Godziny nieznane więc proszę o dyspozycyjność cały dzień.

Stawka 140 płatne przelewem.

Jeśli wejdzie wizerunek będzie dopłata.

Proszę zgłoszenia wysyłać na numer 797169069

Z dopiskiem biuro 17.10

W sms proszę napisać imię, nazwisko wiek oraz wyraźne zdjęcia twarzy i sylwetki.

Czekam na wasze zgłoszenia do 14.10 do 12:00

Odezwę się do wybranych do 15.10 do końca dnia.

Marta 🎥 filmakcja 

Dobrego dnia 🎬🙏😉

💡WANTED: Gaffer to carve light, shape shadows, and serve it up dark.

Paid. Non-union. Feature film. Upstate New York. October 23–November 2.

We’re making a stylized feminist liminal horror.

Are you a fast, fearless lighting magician with bold instincts and zero interest in making anything look ordinary?

You pick the tools from our gear list, we pack the van with toys. 

If you’re it, send your résumé & reel to:

*notherselfmovie@gmail.com*

LOS ANGELES – PAID – NON-UNION – THIS WEEK

Last-minute flashback roles for a scripted thriller short (YouTube, large channel).

BELLA'S MOTHER – Black woman, 50s. Warm, grounded. Little to no dialogue.

BELLA'S FATHER – Black man, 50s. Warm, grounded. Little to no dialogue.

(Casting at least one Black parent; an interracial couple works too.)

→ Thursday, Oct 15, a couple of hours. $100 flat.

THE ROBOT – Woman, 20s, any ethnicity. Plays a humanoid AI out in the real world: still, precise, slightly "off." Movement or dance background a plus.

→ Friday, Oct 16, half day. $200 flat.

Shooting in Los Angeles. Everything provided.

To submit: PM me here on Facebook with a recent photo and the role.

Pre production and production

*Paid*

Essential requirements: some experience with all the legal documents/agreements/contracts/applications.. and crowdfunding. 
Developing a more appropriate breakdown cost.. (finalise budget).

*Must be fairly local ... including and between Manchester - Newcastle radius, otherwise it will be difficult to coordinate etc..

Cheers
     :)

items.text:
Hi! I thought I’d share a little tool I built for myself in case it might be useful to others here.

My daughter does auditions, and I found it surprisingly hard to keep track of everything — submissions, audition requests, callbacks, holds, and shoot dates. Things get scattered across emails and messages, and I wanted one place where I could see everything and keep a history of how things were going.

So I built [CastTrack](https://casttrack.vercel.app/).

It’s a simple casting tracker for parents of young performers. I use it to keep track of where my daughter is with each project and to look back at her audition history and stats.

It’s completely free. I’m a web developer, so it was also a fun project to build for my portfolio, and honestly, I just didn’t want to pay for a tool I needed myself. I’m not planning to monetize it.

My daughter currently auditions mostly through Casting Networks, so that’s what I’ve used it with the most, but it should work with other platforms too.

It’s very much a tool I made to solve my own problem, but maybe someone else will find it useful too. If you try it, I’d love to hear what you think or what could be improved!

[https://casttrack.vercel.app/](https://casttrack.vercel.app/)

items.text:
Hello! 

We are casting for another tourism video filmed out in Kamloops. We are looking for an adventurous couple, approximately 45–60 years old, who have a natural ease, playfulness and convincing chemistry together. We would love to see a couple that can spark off each other, and are able to tease each other in a light hearted way, without taking themselves seriously. 

We’re looking for people who feel:

* Warm, curious, and naturally engaging

* Ready for adventure and enjoy an active lifestyle

* Curious about travel and the people they meet

* Comfortable hiking recreationally

* Relaxed and natural on camera

* One member of the couple must be comfortable driving with a full drivers license 

* Will need a standard American accent

The short video follows a couple through a series of experiences - hiking, biking, wineries, and restaurants. The idea is to showcase that this region has something to offer for everyone; both the adventure seekers and the chill outers. The couple will be reading reviews of the spots as they go along, and find themselves getting curious about what they might discover. 

Details:
- 3 days w/c 19th October
- Day rate range $700-$1000 depending on experience
- Kamloops area, must be able to drive to location

If interested, please complete below submission and email georgia@weareskeletoncrew.ca

**SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS **

For this project, the client is looking for a couple submission only. 

We would love to see you both in frame, side by side, framed from the top of the head to just above chest. 

Please submit:
* Slate
* Scene 1
* Scene 2

**On your slate we would love to see:**
* Name, height, location, union status

**Scene 1**

Describe your last adventure weekend. Where would you go, what activities would you do? What roles did you both play on the trip? Does one of you do the planning, how do you compromise? 

**Scene 2**

Find an online review for any location, coffee shop, restaurant, and read it allowed to your partner. Discuss between you what you think it’ll be like, and you decide to give it a go!

Hallo zusammen,
ich suche nach neuen Einstiegsmöglichkeiten, Projekten oder Open Calls im Bereich **physisches Theater, Live-Performance, moderne Kunstaktionen** und freie/queere Szene als **textilfreier Performer**, Darsteller oder Komparse.

**Kurz zu mir:** Ich bringe außergewöhnlichen Mut für textilfreie Kunst sowie Extreme Body Art mit. Über zwei Jahrzehnte war ich regelmäßiger Teil einer der bekanntesten queeren Partyreihen Deutschlands („Irrenhouse“ in Berlin) und besitze umfassende Erfahrung mit durchgehenden, interaktiven Performances. Auch als erfahrenes Textilfreies Modell (vor allem für dynamische Posen/Wechselposen) stehe ich gerne zur Verfügung.

Da viele Castings in der freien Szene intern laufen, suche ich hier den direkten Weg zu Regisseuren, Choreografen und Kollektiven für Projekte im Raum Leipzig, Mitteldeutschland und Berlin.
* **Mein detailliertes Künstler-Portfolio** mit allen bisherigen Stationen und Interessen **ist direkt auf meinem Facebook-Profil verlinkt**! Schreibt mir bei Interesse auch gerne direkt eine private Nachricht (PN).

Habt ihr Tipps für aktuelle Projekte, Netzwerke oder konkrete Open Calls, bei denen Performer mit Körpererfahrung gesucht werden? Ich freue mich über jede Nachricht oder Empfehlung!

items.text:
Casting für junge Künstler:

Dinnershow im Krönum

**Du bist ein talentierter Künstler und möchtest deine Fähigkeiten in einer einzigartigen Dinnershow präsentieren? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!**

 

Wir suchen junge, kreative Künstler aus den Bereichen Akrobatik, Tanz, Musik, Comedy und mehr, die Lust haben, bei einer exklusiven Dinnershow im Krönum mitzumachen. Du kannst dich auch gerne als Duo bewerben!

 

So kannst du dich bewerben:

 

-   Schick uns ein kurzes Video (max. 3 Minuten) von deinem Auftritt oder einer Performance, die du vor kurzem durchgeführt hast. Zeige uns deine Fähigkeiten und deine Leidenschaft für die Bühne!

-   Wir treffen eine Vorauswahl und laden die ausgewählten Künstler zu einem persönlichen Casting ein, das am 01.10. stattfinden wird. In absoluten Ausnahmefällen ist auch ein anderer Termin auf Anfrage möglich.

 

Warum teilnehmen?

-   Du erhältst die Chance, Teil einer einzigartigen Dinnershow im Krönum zu werden.

-   ﻿Die Shows beginnen im März und enden im Dezember. Gespielt wird an den Wochenenden und in den sächsischen Ferien. Details folgen.

-   ﻿﻿Es warten spannende Auftrittsmöglichkeiten und ein kreatives Team auf dich.

-   Du kannst dich vor einem begeisterten Publikum präsentieren.

 

Bewerbung:

Sende dein Video inkl. Bilder, sowie eine kurze Beschreibung deiner Person bis spätestens 30.09.2026 an [kulti@turisede.de](mailto:kulti@turisede.de).

Infos zum bereits laufenden Krönum: [https://www.turisede.com/kroenum.html](https://www.turisede.com/kroenum.html)

 

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und vielleicht bald gemeinsam auf der Bühne im Krönum zu stehen!

JAB By James McDermott

Venue: Bob Hope Theatre, Wythfield Road, Eltham, London, SE9 5TG 

Jab is a two hander:    **Anne** 40’s - 50’s NHS worker and **Don** 50’s - 60’s Vintage shop keeper 

The play is set during 2020-2021 and is based on the true story about a breakdown of a long marriage during the Covid pandemic. They fall out over the question/dilemma: should they have the vaccine or not?

items.text:
Casting Call for Upcoming Dark-Comedy Musical 'Psychopomp!'

Overview:

Psychopomp! is a new dark-comedy stage musical about the insane lengths that a couple will go to be together. The play is packed with infectious rock and roll, raucous comedy, and bombastic characters - think Beetlejuice meets Alice Cooper. The word 'Psychopomp' refers to the being that brings one's spirit into the afterlife, like Anubis, the Valkyries, Charon on the River Styx, or The Grim Reaper. As the settings and humor of the show dissolve into madness, the play morphs from Romeo and Juliet, to Rocky Horror, to The Addams Family, on an irreverent ride through the afterlife.

General Info:

Performance Location: Upstairs at El Centro in Hollywood, CA

Performance Dates: February 26th, 27th, and 28th (evenings)

Rehearsal Location: TBD dependent upon cast-member locations (first few rehearsals likely in San Fernando)

Rehearsal Dates: Starting Winter of 2026/2027 – time TBD

Union Affiliation: Non-union

Contact info: Justin - psychopomprocks@gmail.com

Compensation: Dependent on role – profits from the show will be paid to cast. On longer rehearsal nights, meals will be provided. The show will be filmed and photographed, and a cast album will be recorded – all available for you to use however you like.

Requested Audition Materials:

-Self tape of a scene/monologue and/or video of previous stage or film work

-Self tape or live video of vocal music performance – rock/pop preferred

ROLES:

TESS – Female - 25-38

Fun, sarcastic punk rock guitarist – Confident, but doesn't take herself too seriously. Guitar experience a plus, but not at all required.

VIKKI – Female - 25-38

Tess' friend – think Rizzo from Grease. Sassy but protective of Tess. And sometimes a little annoyed by her, too.

JAKE – Male - 25-38

Sincere, self-effacing, sorta nerdy - aspiring magician.

LUKE – Male - 25-38

Jake's friend – laid-back, smooth, funny, etc - Cooler than Jake, but that's a low bar.

GUITARIST and DRUMMER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The actual live musicians for the show – upstage throughout show.

GRIM REAPER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The Psychopomp. Tess' sidekick throught the play. Not overly ambitious about their career.

PSYCHIC – Male/Female – no age requirement

Charlatan in a world where all the weird, wild mythology turns out to be real.

MAD SCIENTIST – Male/Female – no age requirement

Beach-bum parrot-head scientist – eccentric but earnest.

OTHER ONE-SCENE ROLES:

COP, BARTENDER, BAND SINGER, CAPTAIN HOOK, CRUELLA DE VIL, CHARLIE CHAPLIN, HELL RECEPTIONIST, HERCULES, 007, AWARD SHOW HOST, HEAVEN SHOWRUNNER – Male/Female based on the character – no age requirement.

NOTE: For most of these roles, the actor will play multiple roles (for example, the person playing VIKKI could also play the CRUELLA).

Feel free to send an email with any questions on the audition process, or any other info you would like!

If you would like to audition for a specific singing role, let me know, and I can send you demos of that character's songs.

Thanks, all! Looking forward to hearing from you!

Tess' friend – think Rizzo from Grease. Sassy but protective of Tess. And sometimes a little annoyed by her, too.

JAKE – Male - 25-38

Sincere, self-effacing, sorta nerdy - aspiring magician.

LUKE – Male - 25-38

Jake's friend – laid-back, smooth, funny, etc - Cooler than Jake, but that's a low bar.

GUITARIST and DRUMMER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The actual live musicians for the show – upstage throughout show.

GRIM REAPER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The Psychopomp. Tess' sidekick throught the play. Not overly ambitious about their career.

PSYCHIC – Male/Female – no age requirement

Charlatan in a world where all the weird, wild mythology turns out to be real.

MAD SCIENTIST – Male/Female – no age requirement

Beach-bum parrot-head scientist – eccentric but earnest.

OTHER ONE-SCENE ROLES:

COP, BARTENDER, BAND SINGER, CAPTAIN HOOK, CRUELLA DE VIL, CHARLIE CHAPLIN, HELL RECEPTIONIST, HERCULES, 007, AWARD SHOW HOST, HEAVEN SHOWRUNNER – Male/Female based on the character – no age requirement.

NOTE: For most of these roles, the actor will play multiple roles (for example, the person playing VIKKI could also play the CRUELLA).

Feel free to send an email with any questions on the audition process, or any other info you would like!

If you would like to audition for a specific singing role, let me know, and I can send you demos of that character's songs.

Thanks, all! Looking forward to hearing from you!

🎬 CASTING CALL — THE NEIGHBOUR

We are currently casting for our upcoming short film **THE NEIGHBOUR**, a psychological drama about a reclusive woman whose carefully hidden past is disrupted when a young girl from next door discovers her secret.

🎭 **ROLES:**

**GRETCHEN - Female, 60s**
A reclusive woman who has spent decades disappearing from the world. After a troubled childhood and a life built around staying unseen, a young girl begins to break through her walls.

**PIXIE - Any Gender, 10–14**
A sharp, observant kid who acts like she has everything figured out. Behind her tough exterior, she is simply looking for someone to step in and protect her.

**ANNIE - Female, 30s**
Pixie’s mother. Exhausted and overwhelmed by life, Annie keeps going because she feels she has no choice. Beneath her sharp edges, she deeply loves her daughter.

**DERIC - Male, 30s**
Pixie’s father. Volatile and desperate, he is convinced he has been wronged. The role requires an actor who can shift from threatening to shaken within a single scene.

📍 **Shooting Location:** Greater Vancouver Area
🎥 **Shooting Dates:** November 20–22, 2026
📅 **Call Backs:** October 22, 2026
📍 **Call Back Location:** 142 Water Street, VFS Film Production

**Union & Non-Union welcome.**
Applicants must be legally eligible to work in Canada.

📩 **HOW TO APPLY**
Please send your **Resume, Headshot, and Demo Reel (if applicable)** to:

**[theneighbour.production@outlook.com](mailto:theneighbour.production@outlook.com)**

Please include the **role you would like to be considered for**.

🗓️ **Deadline: October 15, 2026**

Shortlisted applicants will receive **self-tape instructions**.

If you know an actor who would be a great fit, please **share this post or tag them below!** 🎬

items.text:
**CASTING CALL:** "Rave Hard, Recover Fast", a narrative **SPEC** commercial for Happy Tuesdays (London)

We're PickledFish, an Edinburgh based narrative production company. We're casting two leads for a stylised, Matrix-inspired narrative spec commercial for UK post-rave recovery brand Happy Tuesdays. It's a fully practical production, we'll shoot on the Alexa Mini LF in a professional London studio, with a full professional crew.

See our work: https://pickledfish.tv

After a big night out, Leo collapses on his couch and wakes in an endless white room. A mysterious suited figure offers him a choice: painkillers and a wasted day, or something better.

📅** Shoot: 14–15 Nov, London**

—

**LEO** (lead, male, playing age 21–35, 2 shoot days)

Leo is a committed raver: still dancing when he's running on empty, then waking up bright, sharp and himself again. The role has no dialogue, so it's all physicality and expression. It goes from exhausted and spaced-out, to confused and wide-eyed in the white room, to warm, easy and laughing the next morning.

We're looking for someone who:
* is comfortable dancing on camera
* can tell a story with their body and face, without lines
* is available both days

—

**SUITED FIGURE **(lead, any gender, any ethnicity, playing age 30–65, 1 shoot day)

The Suited Figure is a calm, commanding and slightly unnerving guide who exists in "the moment just before you fall asleep." Think of a hypnotic mentor figure: measured, precise, a little theatrical, with total control of the room. They wear a dark suit, green tie and rimless glasses, which we provide. A homage to a certain iconic character.

We're looking for someone with:
* a strong voice and mesmerising delivery, since this role carries all of the film's dialogue
* stillness and presence on screen
* availability for one day, within 14–15 Nov (we'll confirm the date once you're cast)

—

💷 **Unpaid.** Food and travel are provided along with an IMDb-style credit, and a high-quality copy of the finished film for your reel.

Usage: this is a spec commercial. It'll be presented to the brand, and used on PickledFish's portfolio, online channels and in festival submissions.

—

🎥 HOW TO APPLY

Email your self-tape link, headshot and CV to hello@pickledfish.tv with the role name in the subject line, by Sun 25 Oct. Applications by email only, please. We can't take submissions via DM or comments.

**LEO:** walk to a chair, slump into it exhausted and fall asleep. Then wake up, open your hand, and smile at what you find. A 10–20 second dance clip is a bonus.

**SUITED FIGURE: **record a self-tape of these sides:
"This... is the moment just before you fall asleep. You have a choice to make. Maybe your head hurts a little bit less, but you still wake up sluggish and dazed, stuck in bed as the day marches on. Remember, the choice is yours, yours, yours, yours, yours, yours..."

Z ogromną satysfakcją przyjęliśmy zaproszenie do udziału w tegorocznej Tęczowej Nocy MDK-ów w Katowicach, podczas której właścicielka naszej szkoły Maja Piernikorz, poprowadzi warsztaty aktorsko-dykcyjne wraz z Panią Renata Furdyna! ❤️🎬

Praca z głosem, interpretacja tekstu, świadomość sceniczna i umiejętność wyrażania emocji to fundamenty warsztatu aktorskiego, który nieustannie rozwijamy i którego elementami z przyjemnością podzielimy się z uczestnikami wydarzenia.

Wierzymy, że aktorstwo to nie tylko umiejętność wcielania się w role. To również sztuka komunikacji, wrażliwość na drugiego człowieka oraz odwaga, by wyrażać siebie.

Tym razem nasza trenerka będzie miała przyjemność stanąć po drugiej stronie sceny, nie jako aktorka, lecz jako osoba przekazująca swoją wiedzę i doświadczenie.

Serdecznie zapraszamy zarówno dzieci, jak i dorosłych. 🤍

🎥 SØGER 10 PIGER (18–30 ÅR) TIL YOUTUBE-VIDEO PÅ SØNDAG – VIND 1.000 KR.
Hej! Vi er Chris og Jacob,

Vi søger 10 unge piger til en YouTube-video på søndag den 18. oktober kl. 15–18 på Amager.

Vi skal filme en sjov generalviden-quiz (pige-edition), hvor Jacob og jeg er værter, og 10 piger konkurrerer mod hinanden om 1.000 kr.

Deltagelsen er ulønnet, men vinderen får 1.000 kr. i præmie.

Hvordan fungerer det?

Alle 10 piger starter sammen. Vi stiller spørgsmål om alt muligt, både nemme spørgsmål, pigeting og lidt mærkelige og sjove spørgsmål.

Det gælder om at svare hurtigst rigtigt. Den første, der svarer rigtigt, er videre til næste runde og træder ud af gruppen. Så er der 9 tilbage, og vi stiller et nyt spørgsmål. Sådan fortsætter det, indtil den sidste person er tilbage og ryger ud.

Derefter starter vi igen med 9 piger, så 8, 7 osv., indtil vi har 2 finalister, der skal dyste om 1.000 kr. i finalen.

Det hele bliver filmet med flere kameraer i et studie på Amager og lagt op på vores YouTube-kanal.

Vi har sat kl. 15–18 af for at være på den sikre side, men det kommer højst sandsynligt til at tage kortere tid.

På billederne kan I se referencer til, hvordan kameraopsætningen og vinklerne kommer til at se ud, samt selve studiet, vi skal filme i.

Vi søger bare unge piger (18–30 år), der har lyst til at være med og have det sjovt. Man behøver hverken have erfaring foran et kamera eller være ekspert i generalviden, da det simple spg alle kan være med i og ikke en intelligens test.

Hvis det lyder som noget for dig, eller du vil høre mere, så skriv en SMS til mig på 23 29 87 88 eller på Instagram: christophermarcc

Håber nogle har lyst til at være med! 😄

**STATISTER SØGES TIL AFGANGSFILM – DEN DANSKE FILMSKOLE**

Til afgangsfilmen *ANGELS*, instrueret af Jonatan Egholm Keis og produceret af Astrid Andreasen, søger vi statister af alle typer, køn og aldre til at agere familiemedlemmer/venner til et sølvbryllup.

**Dato:** Torsdag d. 15. oktober

**Tidsrum:** ca. 09.00-19.00

**Sted:** Storkøbenhavn

Lyder det som dig - eller kender du nogen? Så hører vi meget gerne fra dig!

Send en mail til statisten.nu@gmail.com med navn, alder, kontaktoplysninger og et vellignende billede.

Hvis du er under 18 år bedes du desuden angive navn og kontaktoplysninger på en forælder/værge.

Skriv: FESTGÆST i emnefeltet.

*OBS: Kun henvendelser via mail vil blive besvaret.*

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

***Om filmen***

*ANGELS er en rockerfilm uden læderveste, motorcykler, narko og pistoler. Det er en moderne gangsterfilm til den tid, vi lever i, som fokuserer på mennesket bag den kriminelle etikette.*

Deltagelse er ulønnet, men der vil være forplejning på set.

Hey everyone! We’re a team of LA-based indie filmmakers that are part of a community bringing together people working in movies across Los Angeles. Just good people, great conversations, and real connections. We welcome people at every level of their career.

Our mission is simple: Help each other make movies, connect, and network.

We meet in Boyle Heights every 1st Thursday of the month at 6pm.

Whether you're an actor, filmmaker, writer, producer, director, DOP, or working behind the scenes, we'd love for you to join us!

Entrance is FREE, but RSVP is required as space is limited.

**RSVP here:** https://partiful.com/e/lY9sDO0ZosP3nr2bcNVl?c=Y6ysr1LC

Hope to see some of you there! Feel free to share this with anyone in the LA film and TV community.

Drinks and snacks available for purchase.

🎶 Spooky Season is the Perfect Time to Start Piano Lessons! (Start free!)🎶

Hi! I’m Colleen, a voice & piano teacher with Virtuoso Studios, and we have so many exciting things happening in the studio this month! We’re bringing back our annual Spooky Recital, plus a Most Creative Performance Video Contest where students can get creative with their songs, costumes, sets, and performances for a chance to win!

Also, our big recital season is only 3 months away! That means there’s still plenty of time to get started, build confidence, learn some great music, and prepare a performance before recital season arrives. Recitals are in-person in the Milwaukee area at least 2x per year✨

🎶 Voice & piano lessons available virtual Via Zoom�✨ Beginner-friendly and welcoming for kids, teens, and adults�
Interested in giving lessons a try? Fill out our free trial lesson form and I’ll be in touch!
https://www.virtuosostudios.org/free-trial-lessons.html

**Casting Call: 3 Actors for Security-Awareness Videos | Berlin**

We're looking for three Berlin-based actors for a series of 21 short security-awareness training videos for a large cybersecurity company.

**Who we're looking for:**
* Fluent English with a neutral American accent.
* A professional, approachable presence. Open to different ages and backgrounds.
* Natural, expressive delivery with personality - comfortable bringing curiosity, concern, surprise and urgency to educational content.
* We're aiming for a diverse cast, ideally two women and one man.

**Shoot details:**
* One full shoot day in Berlin, date TBC.
* Each actor will present several videos within the series.
* Paid project. Fee and usage terms to be agreed before booking.
* Content will be used for corporate security-awareness training and dubbed into approximately 40 languages.

To apply, please send your headshots, showreel or an English-language performance sample, availability in October, and your day rate. Shortlisted actors will be invited to submit a brief self-tape.

**Contact:** alena@representstudio.com or telegram @xvostikova

items.text:
Mezinárodní filmový festival BRNO16 se řadí mezi nejdéle fungující filmové festivaly v České republice. Od svého založení v roce 1960 se koná nepřetržitě a zároveň patří k nejstarším přehlídkám krátkometrážní tvorby na světě. Představuje široké spektrum krátkých filmů, od hraných a animovaných až po experimentální snímky, a to jak od studentů, tak od profesionálních i neprofesionálních tvůrců. Vedle prestižní filmové soutěže nabízí také bohatý doprovodný program zahrnující výstavy, diskuse a workshopy. Festival každoročně hostí řadu českých i zahraničních osobností, které návštěvníkům umožňují nahlédnout do zákulisí své tvorby a diskutovat o filmech i zkušenostech z filmového prostředí.
___
Plánujete dorazit? 🎬
___
